strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
What are these rock-like things...?
Creepy... They're floating, see?
...Tch, they've got the lab completely surrounded...
Thank you for coming back, all of you.
So far, the Getter Ray amplifier reactor experiment is going smoothly.
Doctor, what kind of experiment is this one?
...In the middle of a war, and while we're surrounded
by some unknown things...! If the enemy attacks now...
It's precisely because of times like these that this must be done.
Peaceful use of Getter Rays... For that, peace must come to Earth,
no, to the universe...
But our Londo Bell comrades' forces are scattered...
Was there really a need to call us back, Doctor?
And we're using the old Getter, not the Getter G...
If this experiment succeeds...
we'll be able to fire up a new Getter Reactor...!
...!! A new Getter Reactor!?
Does that mean... there's a new Getter Robo!?
Is that true, Doctor?
Purely in theory, but relative to the absolute value of Getter Rays,
if the Getter Reactor doesn't go berserk... a stronger Getter results.
Now that's great. I see, so you wanted to hand it to us first...
That's part of it, but... as you've been saying,
when we began the experiment, those rocks appeared from nowhere.
What are those things, Doctor?
Well... It's too early to conclude, but almost certainly...
someone is watching this lab. Those must be their monitoring devices.
What?
Don't tell me the Hyakki guys survived, Doctor?
...I can't say, but... probably not.
They're waiting...? For you to finish the Getter Reactor, Doctor?
I think that's highly likely. That's why I called you here.
I see... Then, Doctor.
Yes, the test now enters its final stage.
If nothing happens, so much the better.
Besides... I can't say the experiment will fully succeed. You all...
Understood, Doctor. We'll crush those rocky lumps with the Dragon.
Right...!
Getter Rays... So there are still guys after them, huh?
Is it really not the Hyakki's revenge?
...Hey, Hayato, those guys watching us... what d'you think they are?
Well... When I hear "unidentified," they're the only ones I can think of.
What!? It can't be...! Doctor, enemy attack!
That enemy... It's the Einst!
Hayato was right... It really was them!?
What is this...! Ryo, Hayato, Benkei!
Buy us some time! The experiment has already begun!
All right! We'll hold them off! Hayato! Benkei!
Yeah, we won't let 'em do as they please!
I'll throw 'em all over the place!
Brother, we're sortieing too!
Yes! Let's sortie!
Everyone, listen closely.
We can't stop the Getter Reactor experiment... now.
...If the enemy destroys the lab... there's no telling what will happen!
(That much Getter Ray energy!? What kind of Getter...!?)
Here we go!
Chaaange Dragon! Switch On!
Come on, then!
Ryo! We've just received word from Londo Bell.
From Londo Bell!? They're coming here!?
That's right. Hold out until then!
Tch, there's a lot of 'em.
And compared to that, we've only got two units... It's tough, ne.
But we're way stronger than they are, many times over!
That's the spirit!
Good, sooner than expected! The enemy hasn't deployed its lines yet!
Dr. Saotome!
Are we late...!? The enemy's moving fast...! Dr. Saotome!
Oh! Londo Bell! Thank goodness!
The enemy is... It really is the Einst!?
If they've shown up at the Saotome Laboratory...
does that mean they're after Getter Rays too?
These rocks lined up like this... like the ones they said were in space...!?
They appeared at Demon Mask Castle too... What could they be after...?
Kosuke! Worry about that after we've chased 'em off!
I don't understand... The enemy is after the Getter Reactor?
A mech with the power of Getter Robo... Isn't that their goal?
Could be. If they're after Getter Rays... that power...
...No, that's not it...!
That's not it... not it...
Cham!?
Something more... more fundamental... about life...
Holy Warrior, what is wrong?
Dr. Saotome! Is everyone at the lab all right!?
You're... Dr. Mikamura's...?
...The Getter Reactor experiment is underway; we can't step away.
Ryo and the others are doing well holding off the enemy, but...
if we ever let the enemy get inside...
If you did!?
...For a while now, the Getter has been resonating with that enemy.
I have no idea what will happen!
Resonating with them...?
You're... Dr. Mikamura's...? There are no casualties so far!
But... since the enemy got in... the old Getter has been acting strangely...
Doctor!? What do you mean!?
...For a while now, the Getter seemed to be resonating with that enemy...
And it's getting stronger and stronger...!
I have no idea what will happen from here...!
Resonating... with them!? Getter Robo... no, the Getter Rays!?
If that Getter Reactor went out of control... what would happen?
Maybe nothing at all, or the whole lab area...
no, all of Japan might be blown away.
That much energy!?
...That is what Getter Rays are.
Chatting is fine, but we'd like some support soon, ne!
Yes!
Cover us, please!
I get that things are getting complicated, though.
We're counting on you!
Everyone, please hurry and save the lab!
Right, let's go! Mike, Lenny!
Okay, Big Bro!
We have to help Ryoma and the others!
Kyosuke Nanbu, Alteisen, heading out...!
Ah! Kyosuke!?
(I've got a bad feeling... Their goal... and this feeling... It's nearby...!)
Unknown energy... Getter Rays! What do you seek in them...!
Kyosuke, what's wrong?
He's lost his focus...? Kyosuke!
...Don't tell me... it's coming!?
Akira, something happen?
What? Raideen is... resonating...!?
...! Th-this is...
Hm! That's...
Wh... the Weissritter!?
The machine of the missing Excellen!
Thank goodness... She's safe!
You idiot! Where the hell've you been wandering all this time!?
Just vanishing without a care... It's been rough on us, y'know.
That's... not right...
It seems there's trouble brewing.
Yeah... any way you look at it, that's not someone here to back us up...
It showed up with the mystery enemy, so there must be a connection...!?
...But that doesn't mean Excellen's the one flying it, right?
The enemy may have stolen only the machine...
Then... what about Excellen...!?
In the worst case...
...No... it's her...
What...!
Hm? What's wrong?
...Nothing.
Tch, the enemy's not gonna wait around for us!
We intercept! Kyosuke... we have no choice but to fight...!
...Roger...
Why... why are Kyosuke and Excellen...!
What in the world's goin' on!?
Hey, Kyosuke, no hard feelings, all right!?
...Tch.
What're those escorts!? Mobile suits...
...no, they're not. But I've seen that shape somewhere before!?
What...!? Could those be...!
...They're Gespensts.
Yes, I saw them too, back when I was a test pilot...
Gespenst... Kyosuke, your machine is also...
Alteisen is the Mk-III.
Only three Gespenst prototypes were ever built, so...
...are those the mass-produced Mk-II!?
But the Gespenst Mk-II units deployed to the Federation Forces...
...numbered thirty-odd, and most of them were lost in the last war...
...Most likely... they were based on the Weissritter...
(The enemy has that kind of technology...?)
Excellen! It's me. It's Kyosuke...! Don't you recognize me!?
You're in there, aren't you!? What... what happened to you!?
Looks like Excellen really is aboard...
But she attacked us... I hope we can bring her back to her senses...
Yeah, I don't wanna fight that girl...
Hang in there, Kyosuke...
...Getter Rays... That... is...
...Getter Rays!? What about that energy!?
What happened to you, Excellen... Answer me.
Excellen...
...Kyosuke...
Excellen!
Ah!
She took off at an incredible speed!?
What the heck! What's going on!?
...That speed... It's nothing like the Weissritter we knew.
So she's all right, at least? Her, I mean.
Yeah. She... seemed to know my name, at least.
But... why...
Battle Mastery increased by 1.
...Kyosuke...
Excellen!
Ah!
She took off at an incredible speed!?
What the heck! What's going on!?
...That speed... It's nothing like the Weissritter we knew.
So she's all right, at least? Her, I mean.
Yeah. She... seemed to know my name, at least.
But... why...
Ngh! The enemy's in the lab...
It seems we've driven off all the enemies.
We kept them out, but... what about the Getter reactor!? Doctor!
I can't tell without a closer look... We seem to have stopped a runaway...
Doctor, then...
Yes... an unexplained resonance... The Getter reactor is very delicate.
The one from the old Getter is already...
I'm sorry, Dr. Saotome... that the lab ended up like this.
Not at all. That all the researchers are safe is blessing enough.
But what happened to the Getter reactor!? Doctor!
I can't tell without a closer look...
When they broke in, the Getter reactor resonated violently.
It seems we stopped the reactor from running away, but... it's hard to say...
So their goal... was the Getter reactor after all?
Were they trying to build some bony Getter, or a plant-like Getter?
But... either way, the experiment has failed.
Once a Getter reactor goes unstable... it's too dangerous to use.
That's a shame...
No... members of Londo Bell, you have my sincere thanks.
No... it seems we weren't much help... with the Getter reactor experiment...
Life comes first. As long as you're alive, there's always a next time.
You sure are upbeat, Doc.
Hahaha, a scientist who isn't upbeat won't last long.
Gramps said the same thing once.
Well, it's a lot better than a pessimistic scientist...
Banjo...?
Still, the Weissritter... it felt strange.
Yeah, what happened?
Kyosuke, did she... say nothing at all?
No...
Kyosuke... you can talk to the rest of us about it, you know?
Fa... don't push him. There may be things he doesn't want to say.
...Most likely... this battle was set up to bring Excellen
face to face with us...
Why would they do that?
So it really was her in the cockpit.
I didn't actually see her, but... there's no mistake.
Hey, at least she's okay, right?
That's right.
As long as she's alive, we'll get a chance to rescue her...!
Indeed... for now, all we can do is pray for Excellen's safety...
It is just as Akira Hibiki says.
So long as we fight this war, we shall have a chance to meet her again.
That machine had the same spiritual power as the enemies around it...
...but if she lives, she may yet return to her true self.
For now, it seems all we can do is pursue our own objectives...
(...She'll... appear before me again... And when she does...)
